body:
TACTICAL FIX (tgw-plan Todo root, two_speed_execution.tactical_fix -- one clean fast-forward commit on tgw-lib main).

BUG (confirmed 2026-09-06 from prod provider_effects + journal): transient eBay API timeouts on the item pipeline are permanently dead-lettered instead of requeued with backoff.

src/tgw/queue/worker_base.py _TRANSIENT_ERRORS already lists ('readtimeout', 120) and ('connectionerror', 120), and classify_dead_letter() matches on the failure's repr(exc) text. But three provider-effect workers, in their generic 'except Exception as exc:' handler, capture the real error into error_detail=f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}' (correct) yet re-raise a TreatmentFailure whose MESSAGE drops the exception type/text -- so classify_dead_letter sees only 'outcome ambiguous' and returns ('dead_letter', 0).

Sites to fix (each raises a generic 'ambiguous' TreatmentFailure that loses the wrapped exception):
  - src/tgw/workers/ebay_stage.py   -- the 'except Exception as exc:' after 'result = stage_draft(...)'; message f'{sku}: provider staging outcome ambiguous'
  - src/tgw/workers/ebay_publish.py -- two sites; message f'{sku}: provider publish outcome ambiguous; reconciliation required'
  - src/tgw/workers/ebay_upload.py  -- two sites; message f'{sku}: photo upload outcome ambiguous'

FIX: at each of those ~5 re-raise sites, append the underlying exception to the raised message, e.g.
  f'{sku}: provider staging outcome ambiguous ({type(exc).__name__}: {exc})'
so classify_dead_letter routes a ReadTimeout / ConnectionError to ('requeue', 120) instead of permanent dead-letter. Retry is safe: stage_draft calls _find_offer first (reconciles, never duplicates) and the inventory_item PUT is idempotent.

DO NOT change: _TRANSIENT_ERRORS, the finish_provider_effect(... state='ambiguous', error_detail=...) calls, the reason_code values, or the separate 'except requests.exceptions.HTTPError' branch.

TEST (offline, no eBay): assert worker_base.classify_dead_letter() returns ('requeue', 120) for a repr(TreatmentFailure) string that contains a wrapped 'ReadTimeout: HTTPSConnectionPool(...): Read timed out. (read timeout=30)'; and assert the three workers' generic-exception path produces a TreatmentFailure message containing the exception class name. Add tests/test_provider_ambiguous_timeout_classification.py or extend an existing worker_base test.

Incident: SKU tgw202505111031393, ebay_stage -- 'stage-draft | ambiguous | ReadTimeout: HTTPSConnectionPool(host=api.ebay.com, port=443): Read timed out. (read timeout=30)'.
